title: KinyaBERT: a Morphology-aware Kinyarwanda Language Model

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the downstream task performance (GLUE, NER, News Categorization) of a dedicated morphology-aware monolingual model (KinyaBERT) against a standard massively multilingual model (XLM-R) and standard BPE-based tokenization models to demonstrate the representational inadequacy and bias of standard architectures toward high-resource, morphologically simpler languages.
